note: Preregistered evaluations and adversarial audits run against this author's systems. Every entry is code-confirmed: reproduced from probe or runner output, not inferred from reading. Confidence intervals are reproduced as recorded at measurement time. No entry is a trading performance claim.

gates.title: Local student vs API primary — block-lane promotion gate
gates.question: Does a locally fine-tuned student agree with the API primary closely enough to take the lane?
gates.consequence: Lane stays api_only. Registry: NOT_PROMOTABLE. No retry with these students.
gates.lesson: The test population was degenerate. l3 answered decline+low unconditionally for all 300 cases; the primary's confidence split was low 236 / med 45 / high 19, and 45 + 19 = 64 — l3's exact score. l3 IS that constant. A comparator proven live is not a test set proven discriminating: every case had one reference answer, so the test could not distinguish a competent model from a stuck one, and actively rewarded the stuck one by ranking it first.
gates.reopenCondition: A test set whose reference answers carry more than one decision class with meaningful mass, re-run at the preregistered n against the same 0.05 gate.

corrections.title: Raw gate-rejection counts vs deduplicated opportunities
corrections.question: The EMA-spread entry gate showed as roughly 80% of all entry blocks. Is it blocking too much?
corrections.lesson: A gate's raw rejection count is not the number of opportunities it cost you. Signals re-fire every sub-tick while a condition holds, so one blocked setup logs thousands of rows. Deduplicated, spread drops from dominating the funnel to roughly 22% — tied with three other gates. Inflation is non-uniform across gates (30x to 1,180x), so it cannot be divided out: a gate's rank changes, not just its magnitude.
corrections.reopenCondition: A dedup-corrected funnel in which spread's effective share leads, or an end-aligned ablation whose marginal-trade bootstrap CI excludes zero against the gate.

audits.title: Does verifyIntegrity actually perform the checks it reports?
audits.method: Adversarial probes constructed against the live demo bundle and run through verifyIntegrity directly — the same call POST /api/audit/verify makes. Re-verified over HTTP.
audits.headline: 117 records resealed from sha256("attacker/genesis") verified fully green — chain, replay and attestation all pass.

findings.summary: attestation reported pass on a payload carrying no attestation digest, echoing back a digest the verifier had just computed from the caller's own input
chain root was caller-supplied; a book resealed from any genesis verified fully green
the run the desk publishes carries no bars, so nobody outside the process could replay it
an empty record set verified fully green — every check true for want of anything to test
sealed record.index was read only by replay, which needs bars the public payload strips
POST /api/audit/verify had no caller anywhere in the product
ok: true without bars means internally consistent, not replayed

shipped: genesis-root, book-populated and record-position checks; attestation goes three-way (pass / fail / warn-nothing-compared)
GET /api/audit/receipt — run plus sealed bars, self-contained, POST-able back for a full replay: pass (1.16 MB with bars vs 273 KB without; 8 MB cap)
src/lib/audit/verifier-adversarial.test.ts — the probes kept as regression tests, each failing against the pre-fix verifier
audits.reopenCondition: Any check added to verifyIntegrity without a matching adversarial probe that fails against the verifier as it stood before that check existed.

audits.title: Do features that report healthy actually produce output?
audits.method: Census of features whose enable-flag was true, asking for each whether it had ever produced a non-neutral return, a written row, or a non-empty snapshot.
audits.headline: Three independent features were enabled, import-clean, zero-error — and had produced no effect for their entire enabled life.

findings.summary: a stop-loss modifier caught every exception and returned the identity multiplier 1.0 with no log; when its upstream feed was down the feature was inert and indistinguishable from healthy
a counterfactual tracker wrote zero rows due to a capacity-vs-rate eviction mismatch; the KILLING WINNERS safety alert iterated an always-empty dict and could not fire
empty tracker state was consumed downstream as 'gates verified safe' — absence read as a passing verdict

shipped: guard-AND-LOG at every fallback call site — a swallow-to-neutral path that does not announce itself is a path nobody audits
data-presence guard before any 'looks safe' conclusion: absence resolves to UNKNOWN, never to PASS
a standing feature-health guard that asks, for every feature claiming to be live, whether it produced output — routed to the existing operator alerter
audits.reopenCondition: A feature reaching production whose health signal is its enable-flag rather than its output, or any fallback path added without a warning-level log.

audits.title: Can a monitor's output vary with the thing it observes?
audits.method: Measured a monitoring guard's journal across two repositories over 33.26 days, counting rows that carried signal versus rows identical to their predecessor.
audits.headline: 31 of 33 rows (93.9%) were identical no-ops; zero rows carried signal after 2026-08-05. Six commits existed only to commit the previous push's row.

findings.summary: the journal was tracked in the repo where the gate never applies and gitignored in the repo where it does — versioned where it was noise, ignored where it was signal
a monitor emitting the same row every run reads as healthy and carries exactly as much information as one that never fires

shipped: the rule: an output that cannot vary with the thing it observes is not evidence about that thing
heartbeat floors on suppression rules — zero trips over N periods forces an assertion of liveness rather than an assumption of it
diff the last two outputs before believing either; identical is a finding
audits.reopenCondition: A monitor shipped without a test that makes its output differ under a changed observation, or a suppression rule shipped without a heartbeat floor.
